combinations.name: Alcohol
combinations.description: The most common factor in GHB emergencies. GHB's dose curve is already the steepest in common use, and a single drink can turn a fine dose into unrousable sleep. Do not combine.

combinations.name: Opioids
combinations.description: Two separate brakes on breathing, pressed at once. GHB comes on fast, so the gap between fine and unresponsive is minutes. Do not combine.

combinations.name: Benzodiazepines
combinations.description: Deep sedation and slowed breathing on top of GHB's steep curve, with no way to titrate. Do not combine.

combinations.name: Other depressants
combinations.description: Gabapentinoids, sedating antihistamines, sleep aids — anything sedating narrows GHB's already-thin margin. If you can't avoid it, cut the GHB dose sharply and never dose alone.
